title: Bridge from componentwise annihilation to torsion-controlled algebraization
statement: For a Noetherian scheme, ideal data, coherent module H, coherent formal module N and map δ to the completion of H, if one positive ideal power annihilates every component kernel and cokernel of δ, then there exist a coherent F, a map a : F → H and a completion isomorphism β : N ≅ completion F factoring δ, with one positive ideal power annihilating the kernel and cokernel of a.

proof.text: Cover X by all affine opens. Construct Hlocal as the actual restriction of H, with its coherence obtained from locality. Restrict N by the explicit termwise formal restriction functor. Each open subscheme is Noetherian because its topology is a subspace of the Noetherian space X.

Choose the canonical quotient-projection-normalized comparison on each open using the restriction dictionary. Its bound clause gives the restricted component kernel and cokernel annihilation with the original exponent t.

Apply the affine algebraization theorem to each restricted coherent formal map. Forget the full-subcategory inclusion of beta and apply congrArg to the underlying natural transformation in its factorization equation; this provides precisely the local triples needed for descent.
Apply descent to the actual open cover, restricted coherent modules, canonical comparisons and supplied local triples, obtaining the global factorization and common positive annihilation exponent.

lean.statement:
theorem torsionControlled_easy_algebraization_bridge
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (J : X.IdealSheafData)
    (H : CoherentModules X) (N : CoherentFormalModule X J)
    (δ : N ⟶ (completion X J).obj H)
    (htorsion : ∃ t : ℕ, 1 ≤ t ∧ ∀ e : ℕ,
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι t).2
        (kernel (δ.hom.app (op e)))) ∧
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι t).2
        (cokernel (δ.hom.app (op e))))) :
    ∃ (F : CoherentModules X) (a : F ⟶ H) (β : N ≅ (completion X J).obj F),
      δ = β.hom ≫ (completion X J).map a ∧
      (∃ s : ℕ, 1 ≤ s ∧
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι s).2
        (kernel a.hom)) ∧
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι s).2
        (cokernel a.hom)))
